business_problem: With its headquarters in Sweden, Epiroc is a leading manufacturer of rock excavation equipment. The company sources premium steel and then processes it at locations across the globe to produce drilling tools and equipment for the mining and construction industries. Epiroc also provides round-the-clock equipment service and technical expertise for its customers.
solution_summary: Epiroc built this solution on Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Power BI. Azure Machine Learning supports model training, evaluation, and deployment for machine learning workloads. Azure Data Factory moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform. Azure Databricks processes, transforms, and engineers large data sets for analytics and machine learning. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users.
